comparison.objective: Hoist and land a suspended bucket on a scaffold deck; unlike damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Rope hauling, suspended-load control, bail handling, and coordinated landing; no fine rotary setting or setscrew work.
comparison.success_condition: Tiered score for safe hoisting, landing, release, and stillness, with hands not under the load. Exact thresholds and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests dynamic suspended-load handling rather than adjustment of an impact absorber.
